raw_site_text: northern part of the Volta region ... Krachi East, Krachi West, Nkwanta North, and Nkwanta South
justification: Study communities lie in four contiguous districts in the northern Volta region; Accra markets were only price-alert reference markets.
note: Greater Accra match came from urban markets named for price alerts, not the study site. The four districts were in Volta at study time (Oti region split off in 2018).
